title.en: Your engine only pushes 1 stroke in 4. So why is it smooth? #shorts
title.id: Mesinmu cuma mendorong 1 dari 4 langkah. Kok bisa halus? #shorts

description.en: A four-stroke cylinder only makes power on one stroke. The flywheel stores that push and spends it through the other three, and the starter motor turns it to start the engine.
description.id: Silinder empat tak cuma menghasilkan tenaga di satu langkah. Roda gila menyimpan dorongan itu dan membagikannya ke tiga langkah lainnya, dan motor starter memutarnya saat mesin dinyalakan.

scenes.en: Your engine only pushes on *one stroke in four*. So why doesn't it jerk to a stop in between?
scenes.id: Mesinmu cuma mendorong di *satu dari empat langkah*. Terus kenapa nggak tersendat di sela-selanya?

scenes.en: Watch one cylinder. The *power stroke* shoves the crank. Then come three strokes where the crank does all the work.
scenes.id: Lihat satu silinder ini. *Langkah usaha* mendorong poros engkol. Lalu ada tiga langkah di mana poros engkol yang harus kerja.

scenes.en: The fix is a heavy disc on the crankshaft: the *flywheel*.
scenes.id: Solusinya piringan berat di poros engkol: *roda gila*.

scenes.en: On the power stroke, it soaks up energy and *speeds up* a little.
scenes.id: Saat langkah usaha, roda gila menyerap energi dan *sedikit lebih cepat*.

scenes.en: Through the other three strokes it gives that energy back, *slowing* a little, and keeps the piston moving.
scenes.id: Di tiga langkah lainnya, energi itu dikembalikan. Putarannya *sedikit melambat*, tapi piston tetap jalan.

scenes.en: In most cars its toothed rim has one more job: the *starter motor* meshes with it to crank the engine to life.
scenes.id: Di kebanyakan mobil, gerigi di pinggirnya punya tugas lain: *motor starter* mengait ke situ untuk menghidupkan mesin.

scenes.en: More cylinders smooth out the pulses, but almost every engine still leans on a flywheel. Follow for more.
scenes.id: Makin banyak silinder, makin halus. Tapi hampir semua mesin tetap butuh roda gila. Follow untuk video lainnya.
